request: Monthly forecast of Tito's vodka bottles in Polk County for the next 5 months

spec.title: Tito's Vodka, Polk County, next 5 months

sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', il.ordered_on)::date AS month,
       'total' AS series,
       SUM(il.sales_bottles) AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line il
JOIN sales.item i ON i.item_no = il.item_no
JOIN sales.store s ON s.store_no = il.store_no
WHERE i.item_no IN ('38177','38176','38194','38178','38174','38179','38185','102747')
  AND s.county_fips = '19153'
  AND il.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
assumptions: Tito's Handmade Vodka identified by all item numbers under this product (all bottle sizes: 100ml, 200ml, 375ml, 750ml, 1000ml, 1750ml, mini and mini 4-pack), vendor Fifth Generation Distilled Spirits
Polk County identified by county_fips 19153, based on store location (county_name = POLK)
Measure is bottles sold (sales_bottles), which adjusts mini-packs to bottle-equivalent counts
History includes all orders from 2016-01-01 through the most recent complete month
Forecast horizon is 5 months as requested

request: How many bottles of each Tito's mini item will sell statewide over the next 6 months?

spec.title: Tito's mini vodka items, statewide, next 6 months

sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', ordered_on)::date AS month, i.item_desc AS series, SUM(il.sales_bottles) AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line il
JOIN sales.item i ON i.item_no = il.item_no
WHERE il.item_no IN ('38194','38185')
AND ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1
assumptions: Interpreted 'Tito's mini' as the two mini-format items found in the catalog: TITOS HANDMADE VODKA MINI (item 38194, 50ml, 5-pack) and TITOS HANDMADE VODKA MINI 4 PACK (item 38185, 50ml, 15-pack).
Measure is bottles sold (sales_bottles), which counts each mini bottle individually even when sold in sleeves/packs.
Statewide means all stores combined, no geographic breakout; each item is forecast as its own series.
History starts at each item's first order date within the 2016-01-01+ window; months with no orders will be filled with 0 by the downstream pipeline.
Horizon requested is 6 months, within the 12-month limit.

request: monthly forecast of Tito's minis in Des Moines for the next 5 months

spec.title: Tito's minis, Des Moines, next 5 months

sql:
select date_trunc('month', il.ordered_on)::date as month,
       'total' as series,
       sum(il.sales_bottles) as value
from sales.invoice_line il
join sales.store s on s.store_no = il.store_no
where s.city = 'DES MOINES'
  and il.item_no in ('38194','38185')
group by 1
order by 1
assumptions: Des Moines refers to the city of Des Moines (store city = 'DES MOINES'), not West Des Moines or Polk County as a whole.

Tito's minis covers both item 38194 (Tito's Handmade Vodka Mini, 50ml, pack of 5) and item 38185 (Tito's Handmade Vodka Mini 4 Pack, 50ml, pack of 15), using sales_bottles which already accounts for mini pack counts.
Measure is bottles sold per month (not dollars or liters), summed across all stores located in Des Moines.
History starts 2016-01-01 and includes all months through the latest available; incomplete latest month will be dropped by downstream processing.

request: Monthly liters of Crown Royal in Mount Pleasant for the next 4 months

sql:

Mount Pleasant refers to the city of Mount Pleasant, Iowa (Henry County), matched via sales.store.city.

request: American vodka sales dollars for each of the five largest counties, next 6 months

spec.title: American vodka, sales dollars, five largest Iowa counties, next 6 months

region.label: Polk, Linn, Scott, Johnson, Black Hawk counties

sql:
select date_trunc('month', il.ordered_on)::date as month,
       s.county_name as series,
       sum(il.sales_dollars) as value
from sales.invoice_line il
join sales.item i on il.item_no = i.item_no
join sales.store s on il.store_no = s.store_no
where i.category_current = '1031100'
  and s.county_name in ('POLK','LINN','SCOTT','JOHNSON','BLACK HAWK')
  and il.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
group by 1, 2
order by 1, 2
assumptions: American vodka interpreted as the 'AMERICAN VODKAS' category (code 1031100), excluding flavored vodka
Top 5 counties selected by all-time total sales dollars in this category: Polk, Linn, Scott, Johnson, Black Hawk
Each county's monthly sales dollars (state_bottle_retail x bottles, as recorded) forecast independently for the next 6 months
Category assigned using each item's current taxonomy (category_current) so historical reclassifications are handled consistently
History begins 2016-01-01 as required; the current partial month is included in history but will be dropped by the fixed pipeline before forecasting

request: How many bottles of whiskey will Ames stores order next month?

spec.title: Whiskey bottles, Ames stores, next month

sql:
select date_trunc('month', il.ordered_on)::date as month,
       'total' as series,
       sum(il.sales_bottles) as value
from sales.invoice_line il
join sales.store s on s.store_no = il.store_no
where s.city = 'AMES'
  and il.category_code in (
        select category_code from sales.category
        where category_name ilike '%whisk%' and category_name not ilike '%liqueur%'
      )
  and il.ordered_on >= date '2016-01-01'
group by 1
order by 1
assumptions: City resolved to Ames, Iowa (Story County); includes all 59 stores ever recorded in Ames.

Whiskey defined as all categories with 'whiskey' in the name except 'Whiskey Liqueur', which is a liqueur rather than a true whiskey (American, Blended, Canadian, Corn, Imported, Iowa Distillery, Irish, Scotch, Single Barrel Bourbon, Straight Bourbon, Straight Rye, Tennessee whiskies).
Measure is sales_bottles (bottles ordered from the state), which is the standard 'bottles' unit including packs of minis counted individually.
History spans from January 2016 through the most recent available month; incomplete current month is dropped by downstream processing.
Forecast horizon is 1 month as requested ('next month').
